extra_secret_patterns.description: JavaScript regular expressions, matched against every string field.

forbidden_globs.description: Paths that records must never cite or fingerprint.

changed_lines_threshold.description: Changes to direct evidence of at most this many lines are labeled small, larger ones large. The label orders review; any change to direct evidence needs re-verification.

max_receipt_files.description: Most files `alethic receipt run` digests before and after a command. Beyond it, coverage is recorded as partial.

ci_provenance.description: Trusted source that may grant ci-verified. 'none' means ci-verified is always rejected.

semantic.description: Run `alethic search` with embeddings by default. Needs @huggingface/transformers and downloads the model once; keyword search needs neither.

model.description: Embedding model for semantic search (default: the ONNX export of EmbeddingGemma 300M).

dimensions.description: Vector length. EmbeddingGemma is Matryoshka-trained, so 768, 512, 256, or 128 all work; smaller is faster and uses less cache.

dtype.description: ONNX weight precision, e.g. q8, q4, fp32.
